pbis.goal:
During a sample run, the analysis Software shall create a json file with the following file name <RunID> in this folder on the instrument: D:/Specific/Data/{instrument_name}/{date}/{experiment_run}
  
Note: The SW also creates json files in subsequent order of data acquisition that is labeled in the following format: {<RunID>_XXX} where XXX is in sequential order of file creation.
pbis.notes: After analysis the team found out that this feature does not require any SW dev. This falls under the analysis team. Removing this from Sprint 2, and this will be later picked up for just test case creation work at a later sprint.

pbis.desc:
Plate Map in the json file
  
For any json file with only the <RunID> in the filename, the well location for an antibiotic and its concentration shall be listed within the json. 
  
Note: An example json is attached. For example, Tobramycin Concentration 2 is located in well ID B11. json files with the filename format: {<RunID>_XXX} will not include the well location for an antibiotic

pbis.desc:
Provide MICs for DAP GP LB

The Analysis shall record the MIC in the excel file (example excel file highlighted below), when applicable, for the antibiotics that are specified in the plate map attached to INFO-12685
  
Note: MICs may not be provided for reasons listed in SW--0009 (such as condensation, SAS, or report menu).
Note: This Software will not display any MIC on the antibiogram, but should record it for downstream data review.
